summary: The best-looking app the factory has made — grained newsprint under a lamp, New York throughout, an answer that takes ink under a red stamp that judges nobody, a front page that prints itself at 112pt, and a night editor who never breaks character — and it is over before it starts: all thirty rounds carry the identical 3-easy/4-medium/3-hard shape, nothing reads the difficulty it prints on every sheet, Pack.swift:80 deals round 1's ten back verbatim on day 31, and there is no Ladder, Mastery, Run or Earned anywhere in it.
fixes: Replace DailyPack.roundIndex's modulo (Pack.swift:76-91) with Mastery over all question ids, day-key seeded so the edition stays shared, so day 31 is ten questions chosen from what got past her — and grow the pack past 300

Add a Ladder keyed on editions filed that moves the easy/medium/hard mix from 4/4/2 toward 1/3/6 past session 150, and make QuizItem.difficulty the field the selector filters on instead of a caption at QuestionSheet.swift:137
Adopt Run in TodayView so a clean sheet is at stake during the ten, printed as a mono chain beside the tally that pencils out on a miss, costing this edition's tier and nothing else
Open one door with play instead of money: an Earned late edition at seven editions filed, five questions built from what got past her, so CategoryStat finally chooses something
End the edition on earned.next(after:) in the editor's voice — 'Nineteen filed. The late edition opens at twenty-one.' — above the countdown at EditionView.swift:180-193, not on a clock

Clamp the verdict stamp to maxWidth 190 anchored bottom-trailing (QuestionSheet.swift:181-189) so it stops covering the pressed answer and hitting the screen edge in dark and at AX5, clear the version footer from behind the tab bar, and outline press-body.svg so the hero does not vanish into the dark canvas

Add a ladder capture to qa.json (there is none, so Escalation had to be read entirely from code), move the demo presses to 6/10/14s with delay 4.0 and the win to 8/12s so the ink sweep and the confetti land mid-frame, and hold the paper canvas at launch so neither strip opens on white
